Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: fishing game boat catalogue photograph, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: Generate one extremely realistic photograph of this fishing vessel, as if shot for a real marine equipment catalogue on location.
Subject: A modest 3.5 metre traditional clinker-built wooden fishing rowboat, warm weathered honey-brown oak planks, three wooden bench seats, two wooden oars resting neatly inside, simple metal oarlocks, no motor or cabin.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet freshwater lake beside a small weathered wooden fishing jetty, distant green reeds and natural forest.
Composition/framing: Show the entire single vessel from an elevated three-quarter bow angle; bow points towards lower left, stern towards upper right. Hull, interior and propulsion appropriate to this vessel must read clearly. Boat occupies about 75 percent of image width with generous breathing space on every side, physically correct scale and proportions. Level horizon.
Lighting/mood: Soft natural morning daylight, restrained realistic colours, gentle water reflections, believable soft shadows.
Materials/textures: Detailed real wood grain or marine metal/fibreglass as appropriate, subtle signs of normal use, realistic waterline and small ripples. Real photographic optics and natural exposure, no excessive cinematic grading.
Constraints: One full-bleed standalone photograph. No people, no lettering, no numbers, no branding, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no border, no collage, no illustration, no 3D-render appearance.
